grounding.states: Mark Carney is the prime minister
grounding.from: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada.
He succeeded Justin Trudeau as prime minister and as Liberal leader.

grounding.states: He is still in office this week
grounding.from: The official site's home page lists his activity as recent as October 11, 2026.

value.answer: Mark Carney. He took over from Justin Trudeau in March 2025 and is still in the job as of this week.
